core.title: Salem Collection with Chancellor Lever, Brass Accents D07-L150x-CHN

text.description_html:
Brass Accents D07-L150x-CHN, Passage Chancellor Leverset

The Salem Collection with Chancellor Lever is a passage lever, which means it latches but has no locking mechanism. Passage function levers are most often used on hall or closet doors. The graceful in the way the Chancellor Lever gently spirals gives the illusion of a continuous line from tip to rose, making this the perfect handle for traditional homes.

Passage (hall or closet): For doors that don't need locking. Latches but does not lock.

Features and Specifications of the Chancellor Lever with Salem Rose:

  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Lever Length: 3-7/8"
  • Rosette Diameter: 2-5/8"
  • Backset: 2"
  • Concealed mounting on Rosette
  • Sold as complete set with all mounting hardware

Sold Individually
